allowed_commands: dotnet build RunCoach.slnx --no-restore with the in-process flag bundle from AGENTS.md; dotnet format RunCoach.slnx --include <files> --no-restore --verify-no-changes; bash backend/tests/scripts/check-prompt-hashes.sh; from frontend/: npm run build, npx vitest run <spec>, npx eslint <files>, npx prettier --check <files>; jq over backend/openapi/swagger.json; NO dotnet test (test host cannot create its named pipe here: record NOT_RUNNABLE_IN_SANDBOX with the error and put the exact command in orchestrator_runs)
lens_task: Lens: SPEC CONFORMANCE. Judge the diff against every acceptance criterion in the spec, one Given/When/Then at a time, and against each decision the spec cites: for each, SATISFIED / PARTIAL / MISSING with the file:line that satisfies it or the gap, in `conformance`. Then check the contracts the spec marks as preserved (existing specs that must keep passing unmodified; idempotency, guards, resume, unit gates where named) and confirm no preserved spec file was edited. Verify the report's file list equals `git diff HEAD~1 --stat`; any extra or missing file is a finding. Verify any wire or event change is exactly the delta the spec names (nullable-additive, codegen regenerated, no upcaster needed) and that any prompt YAML change carries the manifest and eval-cache pairing the spec plans. Check the trademark rule, the logging rule, the migration rule, and comment hygiene from AGENTS.md across the diff. Read the stage report last and mark each of its claims VERIFIED, UNVERIFIED, or CONTRADICTED in `checks_run`.
